/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/data/lyrics/aap-agar-aa-jaate.md')
old=p.read_bytes()
head, rest=old.split(b'romanLyrics: |-\\n',1)
r, tail=rest.split(b'# source_id:',1)
lines=r.decode().splitlines()
del lines[8]
idx=next(i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if 'saron par' in l)
lines.insert(idx+1,'  Aap agar aa jaate baba...')
pairs=[
('shaam e gharibaṅ mein ali duldul sawar','shaam-e-gharibaaṅ Ali Duldul sawaar'),
('zehra','Zehra'),('bekharar','beqaraar'),('khadmon','qadmoṅ'),('rokar','ro kar'),
('baba aap','baba, aap'),('Chinta na shimr chadar','Chhinta na Shimr chaadar'),
('baba ghar','baba, ghar'),('baba sar','baba, sar'),('nahi','nahiṅ'),('choor','chur'),
('Mai bohat','Main bahut'),('majboor','majbur'),('thi darya','thi, dariya'),
('qaime door thay','khaime dur the'),('baba khushk','baba, khushk'),
('hangaam tha chalta','hangaama tha, chalta'),('bhai par','bhaai par'),
('karbala','Karbala'),('dhoop','dhup'),('baba qatl','baba, qatl'),('baradar','baraadar'),
('meiṅ','mein'),('Hogayi','Ho gayi'),('dunya','duniya'),('baba yun','baba, yuṅ'),
('Sogaye','So gaye'),('karbobala','Karb o Bala'),
('Akbar o abbas o asghar qasim e ibne Hasan','Akbar o Abbas o Asghar Qasim ibn-e-Hasan'),
('baba daagh','baba, daagh'),('bunaya','bunayya'),('sakina','Sakina'),
('Dhoondti','Dhundti'),('seena','sina'),('baba dekh','baba, dekh'),
('qayaam','qiyaam'),('Ap agar','Aap agar'),('na mai dekhti','na main dekhti'),
('baba khaak','baba, khaak'),('saron','saroṅ'),('bano e dilgir','Baano-e-Dilgir'),
('bali Sakina','baali Sakina'),('gohar','gauhar'),('chine','chhine'),
('baba kaano','baba, kaano'),('kaano se chinte','kaanoṅ se chhinte'),
('rehaan o safdar','Rehaan o Safdar'),('sar e Karb','sar-e-Karb'),
('Haa usi','Haaṅ usi'),('dobara sar e zindan','dobaara sar-e-zindaan'),
('baba ghurkiyaṅ','baba, ghurkiyaaṅ')]
out='\\n'.join(lines)+'\\n'
for a,b in pairs:
    out=out.replace(a,b)
source=tail.split(b'\\n---\\n',1)[1].decode().strip().splitlines()
assert len(out.splitlines())==len(source)
assert all(a.endswith('...')==b.endswith('۔۔۔') for a,b in zip(out.splitlines(),source))
assert all(c.isascii() or c=='ṅ' for c in out)
updated=head+b'romanLyrics: |-\\n'+out.encode()+b'# source_id:'+tail
p.write_bytes(updated)
assert p.read_bytes()==updated
print(f'{len(source)-1} aligned verses')
